C# & .NET Coding Standards

    Target Framework: .NET 8 / .NET 9
    Always use file-scoped namespaces.
    Prefer Primary Constructors for Dependency Injection in classes.
    Use nullable reference types strictly (#nullable enable).
    Prefer var only when the type is explicit from the right-hand side.
    Use async/await with CancellationToken on all I/O bound methods.
    Write unit tests using xUnit, NSubstitute, and FluentAssertions.
Always create a requirements specification for each project and update it regularly; design it like a roadmap for the project and strictly adhere to this roadmap.
